tools.name: account_link
tools.description: Direct link to the right account page for anything not doable in chat: billing, browser upload, report management. Hand the user the link and guide them.

tools.name: about
tools.description: Platform documentation and info: how it works (Answer, Analytics, Custom Analytics), usage.

tools.name: agent_advisor
tools.description: AI help desk: which analysis fits your question, interpreting results, fixing errors. Multi-turn.

tools.name: datasets_upload
tools.description: Get your data in. Pass `data` as an array of row objects to create the dataset immediately and get a dataset_ref ready for path_resolver; omit it to get an upload link for a file only the user can reach. Add replace_ref (uuid://ID:KEY) with data to REFRESH an existing dataset in place; schedules and

tools.name: datasets_list
tools.description: List and search your uploaded datasets, with fuzzy matching on name, description, and tags. Returns each dataset's uuid:// reference (the `usage` field) for use as dataset_ref in path_resolver and path_tool_run. The id alone ('uuid://dsv2_...') also works for your own datasets and the platform sampl

tools.name: discover_tools
tools.description: Browse the analyses you can run: the ones you commissioned plus the platform Standard Library (prebuilt tools; each result tagged source:'own' or 'standard_library'). Plain-language match; no query lists everything, your own first. Nothing fits? Commission it with path_resolver.

tools.name: tools_schema
tools.description: Get an analysis's parameter schema. ALWAYS call before path_tool_run.

tools.name: review_estimate
tools.description: The estimate as you review it WITH the user: the question as understood, the estimated answer (sample, marked), every place and its question, the page link, a review checklist. Before path_bespoke.

tools.name: adjust_estimate
tools.description: Apply the user's layout wishes to the estimate's page through the layout agent; a new named arrangement, nothing overwritten, no number changes.

tools.name: find_precedent
tools.description: Before estimating: how did we answer this objective before, on this data or any data? Prior packages and library runs with their tools, mappings, bespoke module names, method and verdicts. Platform-wide, read-only.

tools.name: check_tool_fit
tools.description: Before naming a library tool: does it fit THIS dataset for THIS question? Column mapping, missing required inputs, method-fit verdict, the places it delivers. Read-only.

tools.name: package_status
tools.description: Read an analytics package back: status, every run under it, the report link once delivered.

tools.name: my_objects
tools.description: List and search the objects you own across every question: the curated charts, tables and figures of each delivered package, grouped by objective.

tools.name: build_status
tools.description: Check a commissioned build in-chat: stage progress, queue position, rejection reason if the data didn't match the objective, honest ETA, report link when delivered.

tools.name: ask_library
tools.description: Ask a question across all your delivered analyses: a synthesized answer with citations back to specific reports.

tools.name: reports_list
tools.description: Your report library: every analysis delivered, with status and links. Pass semantic_query to search report content in plain language.

tools.name: warehouse
tools.description: Query your org's data warehouse free: browse the catalog (tables with column roles + computed metrics), semantically find data, plain-language ask, or named templates. Requires warehouse enablement (business plans).

tools.name: schedules
tools.description: Standing re-runs of analyses you own: action='create' (weekly/monthly against a re-runnable data reference, connector:// or an https:// link; report emailed after each run), 'list', or 'cancel'.

tools.name: reports_view
tools.description: Get a shareable browser link for a report, viewable without authentication.

tools.name: report_cards
tools.description: Browse a delivered report's individual cards (charts, tables, insights) inline in chat.

tools.name: path_resolver
tools.description: Which path a question about data should take (reuse, rerun, answer, tool_run, estimate, bespoke, ask or none), with the reason, every path's score and time, and the ready input for the path it picks. Executes nothing and charges nothing.

tools.name: path_reuse
tools.description: Hand back the report already delivered for this question on this data. Time: as path_resolver quotes.

tools.name: path_rerun
tools.description: Run a delivered analysis again, on its own dataset or a new one: the same tools and mappings, no rebuild. Time: as path_resolver quotes.

tools.name: path_answer
tools.description: A read of the data (a total, an average, a count, the top group), computed on every row, in this response. When the question is not a read it says so and names the next step. Time: as path_resolver quotes.

tools.name: path_tool_run
tools.description: Run one or more tested library tools on this dataset, with charts and a written report. No custom build. Time: as path_resolver quotes.

tools.name: path_estimate
tools.description: A rough answer over a sample and the layout of the full report, for the person to confirm before anything is ordered. Time: as path_resolver quotes.

tools.name: path_bespoke
tools.description: Order a custom analysis built for this data from a confirmed estimate, optionally with library tools alongside. Needs the person's yes and an idempotency key; a retry returns the first order. Time: as path_resolver quotes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "api-key" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_status, report_cards · Private data: datasets_upload · Public sink: account_link, datasets_upload · Destructive: datasets_upload, discover_tools, package_status, schedules, path_rerun, path_tool_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_status, report_cards · Private data: datasets_upload · Public sink: account_link, datasets_upload · Destructive: datasets_upload, discover_tools, package_status, schedules, path_rerun, path_tool_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
